object_description: compact square main volume with a secondary three-storey building
design_condition: The main building is positioned between the existing school and the public street, forming a cultural square while preserving and extending the surrounding open spaces and tree canopy.

positive.statement: The building makes a self-confident appearance while subordinating itself to the existing school through its eaves height and expression.

position.rationale: Compact low-rise mass and roof profile are visible; eaves relationship to the existing school is not represented.

positive.statement: The Kulturplatz is created as an extended arrival and meeting place.

position.rationale: Arrival space is constrained to the public-facing southern edge, beside the sampled building footprint.

positive.statement: The new building joins the school complex and the public side of the street in a very natural way.

position.rationale: The public-side connection is approximated along the southern building edge; neighboring school and street are absent.

positive.statement: The new structure of the open spaces is pleasantly simple and convincing in its functionality.

position.rationale: Open-space structure is approximated around the building perimeter, with landscape geometry not directly sampled.

positive.statement: The stage system complies with the design brief and its opening to the south offers exciting possibilities for open-air events.

position.rationale: The stage is placed near the southern opening, whose detailed interior arrangement is not distinguishable.

positive.statement: The compact design with a comparatively small building volume has a positive effect on construction costs.

position.rationale: Small compact volume and layered roof form are clearly visible across the calibrated views.

negative.statement: Simplifications in the standard are accepted in favour of the clarity of the building's organization.

position.rationale: The sampled rectilinear envelope visibly communicates a clear overall organization.

negative.statement: The foyer only provides access to spectator areas for large events, while separate hall access is possible only from outside on one side.

position.rationale: Access is approximated at the southern/front side; internal foyer and hall routes are not separable.

negative.statement: The clarity of the appearance and situation requires concessions to individual operational processes and their comfort.

position.rationale: The judgment concerns operational comfort across the building rather than a useful geometric location.
